name: afterzero
description: AFTERZERO: The Last Version of Earth. A cinematic temporal-reality thriller for browsers, phones and tablets.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && cap add android && node scripts/build-www.mjs --patch-native
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && cap add ios && node scripts/build-www.mjs --patch-native
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync && node scripts/build-www.mjs --patch-native
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
